title: Data Drift Remediation Runbook
description: Standard procedures for investigating and resolving data drift incidents.
steps: 1. Collect drift report and identify affected features.
2. Determine drift severity (LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / CRITICAL).
3. Compare current dataset version against previous baseline.
4. Check if model performance has degraded alongside drift.
5. If severity >= MEDIUM and F1 degraded: recommend RETRAIN_MODEL.
6. If severity LOW and F1 still acceptable: monitor, do not retrain.
7. Submit retraining action through policy engine.
8. Evaluate candidate model against production via quality gates.
9. If gates pass: proceed with canary deployment.
10. Monitor canary for latency / error rate / performance.
12. If unhealthy: rollback to previous production model.
success_criteria: Drift score returns below threshold AND model F1 >= threshold for 3 consecutive windows.
escalation: If retraining fails twice, escalate to human operator.
